scope: One bounded internal-mechanical readout proposal. No scientific execution, numerical feasibility, task package, model evaluation, Docker or Git operation. No unrelated candidate search.
apparatus: An explicit neutral electric Lorentz-oscillator sheet on one of two equal masses joined by a known spring. Maxwell jump conditions supply radiation reaction; a finite-clock inert-component displacement measures the force history. This replaces the matched bulk magnetodielectric and needs new calibration; it cannot inherit r1 data or validation.

closure.optical: P_ddot + (f/2)*P_dot + P = f*e; e_r=-P_dot/2; e_t=e-P_dot/2; B_average=e. Units c=epsilon0=mu0=Omega0=area=1.
closure.force: F=P_dot*e equals exterior vacuum stress difference. Full moving-dipole Lorentz coupling p dot (E+V cross B) fixes canonical-to-kinetic conversion.
closure.energy: U=(P_dot^2+P^2)/(2*f)>0; U_dot=e^2-e_r^2-e_t^2. The stationary leading-order optical identity is not claimed as a complete moving finite-amplitude simulation.
closure.readout: z=M*X2(t*)/E at finite specified clock t*, including translation and internal motion. Reflection prevents the original finite asymptotic displacement. Clock and grading ranges remain undecided.

coherent_source.retains: Exact retarded optical oscillator, radiative damping, all oscillator energy, scattering, mechanical spring dynamics and shared stationary calibration.
coherent_source.error: F_source=-P*e_dot: treats the exact stationary electric-gradient expression as instantaneous mechanical force. F-F_source=d(P*e)/dt.
coherent_source.shared_checks: Both vanish for f=0, have equal stationary cycle averages and complete-pulse impulse. The omitted derivative can affect finite component displacement.
coherent_source.causal_repair: Hold fitted f, optical P(t), geometry and spring solver fixed; replace only the force assignment.

calibration.apparatus: Separate held-sheet harmonic preparation, measured mean supporting force, then remove support before pulse.
calibration.identifiability: Strictly increasing in positive f at each nonzero off-resonant omega; shared identically for both force laws. This proves noiseless identification, not noisy robustness.

additional_archive_scope: AUTHOR files for quantum-residence and dipole-recoil read. Quantum-residence outcome ledger read; no new raw-trajectory reread for those two families. Distinct stationary entrance interference and electric/magnetic recoil mechanisms, respectively.
minimality_and_decision: The spring is only a known filter, not substantive hardening by itself. The new physical issue is using a stationary force law for transient material acceleration. The explicit sheet model closes the ambiguity within its stated approximation, but broad optical-force overlap, possible easy Lorentz repair, signal size, time-window choice and runtime remain unresolved. Independent closure/overlap review should precede any decision about one bounded feasibility calculation; no ready r2 or family-exhaustion claim.
independent_reference: Evolve Maxwell field plus charged sheet using jump-condition or symmetric thin-sheet refinement; extract mechanical force from exterior vacuum stresses; integrate Newton dynamics. Compare against frequency-domain retarded oscillator plus Lorentz force and mechanical Green function. Do not insert compact oracle/source force into the reference.
